content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional payment platforms impose barriers on digital creators, especially in regions with currency instability or stringent regulations. By utilizing decentralized payment systems, you can achieve true financial sovereignty. This infrastructure allows full ownership of your sales process, ensuring that you’re not beholden to third-party fees or policies. NOWPayments offers a low-cost solution, charging only 0.5%, which is a fraction of what platforms like Gumroad demand. This model empowers you to retain more profit and maintain complete control over your transactions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you set up your sovereign digital commerce stack, gather the necessary tools. Start with a domain name for branding and a reliable hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. You will need a script for backend logic, which can be achieved with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Choose a storage solution for order management, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery service like Google Drive. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for automated cryptocurrency transactions. With these components in place, you’re ready to build your sales platform.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To create a seamless payment experience for your customers, configure your payment and delivery pipeline effectively. Start by setting up your NOWPayments account to handle Bitcoin transactions. Next, implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate order processing and delivery. This ensures that when a customer makes a purchase, they receive instant access to their digital product. Test the entire process from payment to delivery to ensure everything works smoothly before launching your store. This automation not only saves time but also enhances customer satisfaction.
Retain 99.5% of your revenue by avoiding platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place and tested, it's time to go live. Market your ebook through social media channels, utilizing targeted advertising to reach potential buyers. Direct them to your newly established store where they can purchase using Bitcoin. Monitor your first transaction closely to ensure that all components—from payment processing to product delivery—function as intended. This initial sale will provide valuable insights into refining your process and enhancing the customer experience. After successfully processing your first transaction, you’ll have the confidence to scale your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your digital store is operational, consider strategies for scaling your business. Analyze customer feedback to improve product offerings and optimize your sales funnel. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access advanced tools and templates that streamline operations. This kit provides blueprints for additional features, allowing you to expand your product range and enhance user engagement. Continuously test and iterate on your marketing strategies to drive traffic and increase sales. Investing time in these efforts will ensure sustained growth and profitability.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, establish a sovereign digital commerce stack using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to accept Bitcoin with minimal fees and full control over your sales process. You retain 99.5% of your revenue, enabling greater profitability compared to platforms that charge significant transaction fees.
Automate delivery for instant customer satisfaction.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack that utilizes NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. This infrastructure allows you to retain full control and avoid traditional payment platform fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees is to use a combination of decentralized hosting, automated delivery systems, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. This approach minimizes costs and maximizes your earnings.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, by deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip. This infrastructure allows you to manage payments and deliveries independently.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This allows you to keep more of your revenue.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?

Yes, you can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to trigger file delivery upon successful payment confirmation. This enhances the customer experience and saves you time.
